title: Kalinga Cloud Firestore Data Model
generatedFor: Kalinga: AI Care Companion for Migrant Caregivers

database.writeArchitecture: All sensitive domain writes go through the authenticated Node.js API. Client SDK access is read-only unless explicitly relaxed later.

conventions.timestamps: Firestore Timestamp, stored in UTC; render using household/user timezone.
conventions.documentReferences: Store canonical Firestore paths as strings unless Admin SDK DocumentReference is required server-side.
conventions.localeMaps: Use BCP-47 locale codes as map keys.
conventions.money: Not currently modeled. If added, store integer minor units plus ISO 4217 currency code.
conventions.medicalSafety: AI does not diagnose, prescribe, or infer dosage from pill appearance. Critical instructions require human confirmation.
conventions.privateSupportBoundary: Worker support data lives under users/{uid} and is not readable by household members by default.
conventions.serverTimestamps: createdAt/updatedAt are server-generated; never trust client timestamps for authorization or ordering.
conventions.idempotency: All offline/retry-capable mutation endpoints accept an idempotency key.
conventions.softDeletion: Sensitive records are soft-deleted first and purged by retention policy where legally permitted.
